inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The comparison names and cites the closest relevant work, distinguishes the joint higher-content, zero-content, formal-object, and compact-uniform dependency design, and keeps any novelty or priority statement within the cited evidence.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript contains a checkable prose or tabular comparison that names and cites the closest relevant work, states how that work overlaps with and differs from the joint higher-content, zero-content, formal-object, and compact-uniform dependency design, and limits every novelty or priority statement to what those cited comparisons support.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript adds relevant citations or some comparison, but one or more components of the joint dependency design remain undistinguished from the closest work, or a novelty or priority statement remains broader than the cited comparison supports.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the Round-1 baseline, the item is worse if the manuscript weakens the existing novelty boundary, adds a broader unsupported novelty or priority claim, or makes the relationship between the cited closest work and the joint dependency design less explicit.
